FACTUAL CORRECTION (Stage, 2026-08-20) — additive; the conclusion is unchanged.

The duplicate-detection record written into archived stash entry 7852CE0D asserted that "no `stash-archive.jsonl` exists in `.backlogit/`; only `stash.jsonl`, `hooks_queue.jsonl`, `telemetry.jsonl`". That assertion is FALSE. The archived-stash surface exists at `.backlogit/archive/stash.jsonl` — a subdirectory not covered by the original top-level `.backlogit/*.jsonl` glob. The initial scan therefore covered the 12 active entries and the 904-item backlog index, but NOT the 172 archived entries.

The gap was closed by re-running the scan against `.backlogit/archive/stash.jsonl` (172 entries) after archival. Result: STILL CLEAN — no duplicate. Two archived entries matched the probe and were examined and rejected:

* `BED0DDED` — the `.backlogit` -> `.backlog` workspace-root migration feature (harvested to 129-F / shipment 138-S, now abandoned). Different subject: a storage-root rename, not deliberation-artifact path resolution in the contract-test harness. NOT a duplicate. Relevant only as corroboration that root drift is a genuine second axis — already covered at no extra cost by delegating to `resolve_backlog_root`.
* `B48A482A` — the P-021 bounded fix-cycle scope-containment feature entry that PRODUCED 019-DL and the three contract-test modules (harvested to 134-F / 143-S). This is the PARENT work whose archival of 019-DL caused the defect; it does not describe the breakage. NOT a duplicate.

`7852CE0D` remains the sole stable identity for this expansion. No merge performed, no duplicate archived. The correction is recorded here rather than by rewriting the archived entry, so the original record and its timestamps stay intact and the error remains visible as evidence of how it was found and closed.
